hits.text: ### 方案 B:fork 根治(follow-up,随下次 vendor-* 重发)
- All support SNI at the protocol level and traybus implements the protocol; awaiting per-environment verification.
- Unit-test self-consistency ≠ interop: protocol issues are located with dbus-monitor on the real bus; GNOME panel-side exceptions show up in journalctl.

that really has UPower, turning the degradation test into a false pass. BecomeMonitor is rejected on the system bus (both dbus-monitor and busctl monitor), so capture is unavailable; verification goes through the probe's own round trips plus busctl call to cross-check reply shapes.
